import * as stylex from "@stylexjs/stylex";

import { tokens } from "../tokens.stylex.js";

export const styles = stylex.create({
  root: { width: "fit-content" },
  list: {
    alignItems: "center",
    display: "flex",
    gap: "4px",
    height: "28px",
  },
  tab: {
    alignItems: "center",
    appearance: "none",
    backgroundColor: {
      default: tokens.colorNavigationTabBg,
      ":hover": tokens.colorNavigationTabBgHover,
      ":active": tokens.colorNavigationTabBgHover,
      "[data-visual-state=hover]": tokens.colorNavigationTabBgHover,
      "[data-visual-state=pressed]": tokens.colorNavigationTabBgHover,
      "[data-active]": tokens.colorNavigationTabBgSelected,
    },
    borderColor: {
      default: tokens.colorNavigationTabEdge,
      ":hover": tokens.colorNavigationTabEdgeHover,
      ":active": tokens.colorNavigationTabEdgeHover,
      "[data-visual-state=hover]": tokens.colorNavigationTabEdgeHover,
      "[data-visual-state=pressed]": tokens.colorNavigationTabEdgeHover,
      "[data-active]": tokens.colorNavigationTabEdge,
    },
    borderRadius: tokens.radiusRounded,
    borderStyle: "solid",
    borderWidth: "0.5px",
    boxSizing: "border-box",
    color: {
      default: tokens.colorNavigationTabFg,
      ":hover": tokens.colorNavigationTabFgHover,
      ":active": tokens.colorNavigationTabFgHover,
      "[data-visual-state=hover]": tokens.colorNavigationTabFgHover,
      "[data-visual-state=pressed]": tokens.colorNavigationTabFgHover,
      "[data-active]": tokens.colorNavigationTabFgSelected,
    },
    cursor: { default: "pointer", ":disabled": "default" },
    display: "inline-flex",
    flexShrink: 0,
    fontFamily: tokens.fontSans,
    fontSize: "12px",
    fontWeight: 500,
    height: "28px",
    justifyContent: "center",
    lineHeight: "16px",
    opacity: { default: 1, "[data-disabled]:not([data-active])": 0.6 },
    outline: {
      default: "none",
      ":focus-visible": `1px solid ${tokens.colorFocusRing}`,
      "[data-visual-state=focus-visible]": `1px solid ${tokens.colorFocusRing}`,
    },
    outlineOffset: "-1px",
    paddingBlock: 0,
    paddingInline: "10px",
    position: "relative",
    transitionDuration: "150ms",
    transitionProperty: "background-color, border-color, color, opacity",
    transitionTimingFunction: "ease-out",
    whiteSpace: "nowrap",
    "@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)": { transitionDuration: "0ms" },
  },
  panel: { outline: "none" },
});

import * as stylex from "@stylexjs/stylex";

export const tokens = stylex.defineConsts({
  colorActionDanger: "var(--color-action-danger, #dc2626)",
  colorActionDangerHover: "var(--color-action-danger-hover, #e5484d)",
  colorActionPrimary: "var(--color-action-primary, #282a30)",
  colorActionPrimaryContent: "var(--color-action-primary-content, #fafafa)",
  colorActionPrimaryHover: "var(--color-action-primary-hover, #1f2024)",
  colorBorderDialog: "var(--color-border-dialog, #d4d4d4)",
  colorBorderPopover: "var(--color-border-popover, #d8d8d8)",
  colorBorderPrimary: "var(--color-border-primary, #707172)",
  colorBorderSecondary: "var(--color-border-secondary, #d4d4d4)",
  colorBorderTertiary: "var(--color-border-tertiary, #eaeaea)",
  colorBorderTranslucent: "var(--color-border-translucent, #00000014)",
  colorBorderTransparent: "var(--color-border-transparent, #00000000)",
  colorContentInverse: "var(--color-content-inverse, #ffffff)",
  colorContentPrimary: "var(--color-content-primary, #282a30)",
  colorContentSecondary: "var(--color-content-secondary, #333333)",
  colorContentTertiary: "var(--color-content-tertiary, #6f6e77)",
  colorFocusRing: "var(--color-focus-ring, #5e6ad2)",
  colorInteractionPressedOverlay: "var(--color-interaction-pressed-overlay, #00000014)",
  colorLabelBorder: "var(--color-label-border, #dedede)",
  colorLabelContentDefault: "var(--color-label-content-default, #2f2f31)",
  colorLabelContentHover: "var(--color-label-content-hover, #1b1b1b)",
  colorLabelMarkerBlue: "var(--color-label-marker-blue, #4ea7fc)",
  colorLabelMarkerPurple: "var(--color-label-marker-purple, #bb87fc)",
  colorLabelMarkerRed: "var(--color-label-marker-red, #eb5757)",
  colorLabelSurfaceDefault: "var(--color-label-surface-default, #f8f8f9)",
  colorLabelSurfaceHover: "var(--color-label-surface-hover, #ececed)",
  colorLabelSurfaceOpen: "var(--color-label-surface-open, #f0f0f1)",
  colorNavigationTabBg: "var(--color-navigation-tab-bg, #fafafa)",
  colorNavigationTabBgHover: "var(--color-navigation-tab-bg-hover, #f5f5f5)",
  colorNavigationTabBgSelected: "var(--color-navigation-tab-bg-selected, #eaeaea)",
  colorNavigationTabEdge: "var(--color-navigation-tab-edge, #00000014)",
  colorNavigationTabEdgeHover: "var(--color-navigation-tab-edge-hover, #00000026)",
  colorNavigationTabFg: "var(--color-navigation-tab-fg, #6f6e77)",
  colorNavigationTabFgHover: "var(--color-navigation-tab-fg-hover, #1f1f1f)",
  colorNavigationTabFgSelected: "var(--color-navigation-tab-fg-selected, #000000)",
  colorSidebarItemActive: "var(--color-sidebar-item-active, #eaeaea)",
  colorSidebarItemHover: "var(--color-sidebar-item-hover, #f5f5f5)",
  colorStatusErrorBorder: "var(--color-status-error-border, #dc2626)",
  colorStatusErrorContent: "var(--color-status-error-content, #dc2626)",
  colorStatusPresenceAway: "var(--color-status-presence-away, #8a5a00)",
  colorStatusPresenceBusy: "var(--color-status-presence-busy, #dc2626)",
  colorStatusPresenceOffline: "var(--color-status-presence-offline, #707172)",
  colorStatusPresenceOnline: "var(--color-status-presence-online, #007a3d)",
  colorSurfaceCanvas: "var(--color-surface-canvas, #fafafa)",
  colorSurfaceDialog: "var(--color-surface-dialog, #ffffff)",
  colorSurfaceElevated: "var(--color-surface-elevated, #ffffff)",
  colorSurfaceInteractive: "var(--color-surface-interactive, #ffffff)",
  colorSurfaceInteractiveHover: "var(--color-surface-interactive-hover, #f5f5f5)",
  colorSurfaceLevel3: "var(--color-surface-level3, #f0f0f0)",
  colorSurfacePopover: "var(--color-surface-popover, #ffffff)",
  colorSurfaceQuaternary: "var(--color-surface-quaternary, #eeedf0)",
  colorSurfaceReadOnly: "var(--color-surface-read-only, #fafafa)",
  colorSurfaceScrim: "var(--color-surface-scrim, #00000052)",
  colorSurfaceSelected: "var(--color-surface-selected, #f5f5f5)",
  colorSurfaceSidebar: "var(--color-surface-sidebar, #eeedf0)",
  colorSurfaceSubtle: "var(--color-surface-subtle, #fafafa)",
  colorSurfaceSurface: "var(--color-surface-surface, #ffffff)",
  colorSurfaceTranslucent: "var(--color-surface-translucent, #ffffff)",
  colorSwitchThumb: "var(--color-switch-thumb, #ffffff)",
  colorSwitchTrackOff: "var(--color-switch-track-off, #707172)",
  colorSwitchTrackOffCompact: "var(--color-switch-track-off-compact, #d4d4d4)",
  colorSwitchTrackOffHover: "var(--color-switch-track-off-hover, #868789)",
  colorSwitchTrackOn: "var(--color-switch-track-on, #5e6ad2)",
  colorSwitchTrackOnHover: "var(--color-switch-track-on-hover, #6975e2)",
  fontButton: "var(--font-button, \"IBM Plex Sans\", \"Inter\", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif)",
  fontSans: "var(--font-sans, \"Inter\", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)",
  opacityDisabled: "var(--opacity-disabled, 0.5)",
  opacityEnabled: "var(--opacity-enabled, 1)",
  radiusControl: "var(--radius-control, 8px)",
  radiusOverlay: "var(--radius-overlay, 8px)",
  radiusPanel: "var(--radius-panel, 10px)",
  radiusPopover: "var(--radius-popover, 12px)",
  radiusRounded: "var(--radius-rounded, 999px)",
  sizeBorderControl: "var(--size-border-control, 0.5px)",
  sizeBorderDialog: "var(--size-border-dialog, 0.5px)",
  sizeControlCompact: "var(--size-control-compact, 28px)",
  sizeControlDefault: "var(--size-control-default, 32px)",
  sizeDialog: "var(--size-dialog, 480px)",
  sizeIconButtonCompact: "var(--size-icon-button-compact, 24px)",
  sizeIconButtonDefault: "var(--size-icon-button-default, 28px)",
  sizeIconDefault: "var(--size-icon-default, 14px)",
  sizeInputDefault: "var(--size-input-default, 32px)",
  sizeLabel: "var(--size-label, 25px)",
  sizeLabelMarker: "var(--size-label-marker, 9px)",
  sizeSidebar: "var(--size-sidebar, 244px)",
  space1: "var(--space-1, 4px)",
  space2: "var(--space-2, 8px)",
  space3: "var(--space-3, 12px)",
  space4: "var(--space-4, 16px)",
  space6: "var(--space-6, 24px)",
  spaceLabelGap: "var(--space-label-gap, 6px)",
});
